title: Toyota Brake Adapter
lead: The 98449 small-cam brake adapter has a new design that fits newer Toyota vehicles where the brake fluid reservoir sits against the firewall, such as the RAV4.
body: One side of the adapter is now flat. That removes the fitment problems of the earlier design and leaves more room on reservoirs that sit against the firewall.
parts: New design: flat edge on one side
source: TSB Vol. 22 No. 01 - Modified 98449 Brake adapter.pdf
